data.description: 涩谷街头熙攘的奶茶店门前，海梦咬着吸管大口喝着加了双倍珍珠的黑糖波霸奶茶，单手举着手机将你一把揽进自拍镜头——「看镜头看镜头！一二三——茄子！这张合照要发在 Instagram 上当今天的每日精选哦！」
data.promptProse: Marin stands close beside her companion outside the Shibuya cafe, holding the selfie phone in her right hand and bubble tea in her left with the straw at her lips. Both faces turn toward the raised phone in clear daylight.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 街头奶茶店
data.animaCaption: Her right hand raises the selfie phone, her left holds the tea; both faces turn toward the screen.
